relevance_note: Case series of three Chinese children with Blau syndrome and NOD2 variants: 'we describe three Chinese patients' with R334Q (Patients 1 and 2) and 'p.M513K' (Patient 3).
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; JSON assembled with a short Python script from values I typed, and every span checked verbatim against the paper by script. Table 1 has patients as columns headed '1', '2', '3' (Patient 1, 2, 3 in the text); the label rule 1 uses the text labels. Table 1 '+'/'-' symbols (Family history, Joint, Skin, Eye, Fever) are not defined in a legend, so they were not used as evidence; exclusions come from the case-report text. In-scope relatives: the mother of Patients 1 and 2 (carrier of R334Q per Fig. 1D legend; no phenotype given) and both parents of Patient 3 (tested negative; recorded as 'parent of Patient 3' and 'parent of Patient 3 2'). Contradictions: (1) Patient 2's variant is 'R334D' in the case text but 'R334Q' in Table 1, the Background ('Patient 1 and Patient 2 (R334Q)') and the Fig. 1D legend; recorded R334Q, not R334D. (2) The Conclusions say 'Arthritis, uveitis, and rash improved on this drug' for the 3 children, whereas each case text says no uveitis and Patients 1 and 2 had no rash; the group statement names no person, so per-person exclusions were kept. (3) Discussion says 'In these 3 patients, TNF-alpha inhibitor therapy failed' but Patient 3's case report lists no TNF inhibitor; treatment summary follows the case text. (4) Patient 1: text says lab tests abnormal including CRP, while Table 1 CRP 7.6 mg/L is within the stated reference ≤8.2 (text units mg/dL vs table mg/L). (5) Fig. 2 legend and text refer to Fig. 2A/2B inconsistently. Patient 2 age at diagnosis taken from Table 1 (6.8 years); his earlier diagnosis of systemic JIA at 5 years is a different diagnosis. Patient 3 inheritance recorded 'de novo' because 'the parents did not carry this mutation' (both parents tested negative); the paper does not use the word de novo. Patient 3 'elevated CRP' is read from Table 1 value 35.5 against the printed reference ≤8.2. cDNA '1001G>A' is printed without a 'c.' prefix and is recorded as printed; protein 'R334Q' likewise without 'p.'. Mother's zygosity left not reported (the Background 'each patient and their pedigrees' statement is not specific to her).
